## Introduction

This is a test document to verify that the CT2 integration fix works correctly.

The system should automatically select the optimal CT2 model for English to French translation.

## Key Points

- Fast translation speed with INT8 quantization
- CPU-optimized CTranslate2 backend
- Automatic language-aware model selection

## Conclusion

If you see this translated to French using the opus_mt_en_fr_ct2_int8 model, the fix is working!
